## Ad Hoc Section Logic

- Source tables:
  - `gold.intelligence_zone_inputs`
  - `gold.transport_built_form_wide`
  - `gold.social_infra_wide`
- Initial tract proxy bundle:
  - `walkability_index`
  - `jobs_access_45min_transit`
  - `pct_commute_transit`
  - `pct_commute_walk`
- First-pass metric: within-Richmond z-score average of the four tract proxy fields above
- Carry-forward artifact: tract-level amenity/accessibility proxy ready for later zone rollup

## What Richmond Can Already Support

- A directional separation between higher-access and lower-access tracts using Gold-only proxies
- A metro context read on transit use, walk commuting, zero-car households, and broadband access
- A provisional amenity/accessibility input for later corridor work

## What Still Needs Shared Upstream Work

- POI pipeline for groceries, parks, hospitals, and cultural venues
- Geometry strategy for the metro infrastructure/context map
- Zone rollup once the Act 4 method is chosen
